text:
jia_research: kicking off intake for harrier-13b. Goal: a reproducible 4-bit chat build that guarantees atomic tool calls and exact JSON output for payments/invoice extraction. Keeping this lean — we need a prioritized checklist and clear gating.

rachel_product: tagging high priority for any prod-facing chat flows. Product constraints: keep system-prompt behavior identical, P50 <200ms on short queries, and invoice-field F1 >= 0.92 on canonical set. If any fail, hold rollout. :stop_sign:

alex_ml: quick bring-up checklist (short bullets):
- ingest model + record sha256 + config snapshot
- baseline LM evals + quick safety checks
- quant matrix: 8-bit PTQ, 4-bit PTQ (group32/group64), one QAT attempt if needed
- chat template + tool-call atomicity smoke tests
- structured-output validation against invoice_schema_v2 + fuzzing
- perf sweeps: kv-cache warmup 32/128, seq len 32/128, memory, latency profiles
- hook regression thresholds into eval runner

sam_infra: infra plan: reserve one p4d for quant tuning and one a10g for throughput runs. NVTX profiling on. Dynamic batching OFF for tool calls to avoid mixing responses. Try per-channel and per-tensor quant and log memory patterns. I'll open infra tickets and reserve windows.

alex_ml: canonical chat template for the harness (copy to eval runner):

````
SYSTEM: You are an assistant that MUST output exactly one JSON object validating against `invoice_schema_v2` or a single error object: {"error":"missing_fields","missing_fields":[...]} . Do NOT emit any prose outside the JSON.
USER: "Extract invoice fields and call the tool `create_invoice` with the exact JSON body. If uncertain, return the error object. Always return JSON."
````

alex_ml: tool spec (pseudo):
````
create_invoice({
  "invoice_id":"str",
  "date":"YYYY-MM-DD",
  "total":float,
  "line_items":[{"desc":"str","qty":int,"unit_price":float}],
  "customer":{"name":"str","id":"str"}
})
````

alex_ml: SDK smoke curl (non-prod token):
````
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"harrier-13b-4bit","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"..."},{"role":"user","content":"..."}],"tools":["create_invoice"],"stream":false}'
````

jia_research: evaluation plan (high level):
- dataset: 250 canonical invoice examples + 60 adversarial/noisy variants (OCR artifacts, truncated totals, nonstandard dates)
- metrics: per-field precision/recall/F1, parse-error-rate, hallucination-rate (spot-check), latency P50/P95
- baselines: prod-chat-tuned-7b and harrier-13b-fp16
- quant sweep: 8bit_ptq, 4bit_ptq (group32 & group64), 4bit_qat if QAT feasible. Track failure modes per variant.

rachel_product: gating rules: any F1 drop >2% vs prod baseline -> block. Latency P95 >1s -> soft-block; require mitigation plan. Also require parse-error-rate <1% on canonical set for rollout.

sam_infra: runtime knobs for experiments: bitwidth, group_size, per_channel true/false, kv_cache_prefetch true/false. Also run with kv-cache warmup ~128 tokens. I'll add these as parameters in the job config.

alex_ml: evaluation parser policy: two-pass parsing — (1) strict JSON parse and fail-hard, (2) tolerant recovery pass that attempts fixes (unquoted keys, trailing commas, stray prose). Record both parse flags and normalized JSON output.

rachel_product: I'll draft an SDK integration checklist covering: calling tool endpoints, expected success/failure payloads, HTTP status codes, retry semantics, and common error cases. Will open doc PR after quant results land.

ci-bot: nightly summary: harrier-fp16 beats prod-chat-tuned-7b by +0.9% F1 on the invoice set. Starting quant sweep run_id=qs-2026-03-20-11 params=[4bit_ptq,group32,per_channel=true]. ETA ~02:10 UTC. :robot_face:

jia_research: owners & action items:
- alex_ml: publish quant experiment matrix + RNG seeds (due EOD)
- sam_infra: reserve hardware & wire profiling (due EOD)
- rachel_product: confirm gating thresholds & doc checklist (tomorrow 11:30)
- jia_research: finalize prompt set + golden answers (in progress)

sam_infra: I'll run one end-to-end smoke with streaming disabled and dynamic batching OFF. Ping me if you want to join the profiling window.

alex_ml: artifact format for CI: one-line CSV per sample + JSON artifact per run containing keys: input_text, output_raw, parse_strict_ok (bool), parse_recovered_ok (bool), normalized_json. Upload to s3://redwood-evals/harrier/onboard/{run_id}/

ci-bot: quant run started: run_id=qs-2026-03-20-11, params=[4bit_ptq,group32,per_channel=true], expected finish 02:10 UTC. Will post failing samples into this thread.

rachel_product: please drop final numbers here. We'll decide rollback gating in the rollout doc after review.

jia_research: thanks all — tagging @alex_ml @sam_infra @rachel_product. Will follow up with run artifacts and eval dashboard links when CI posts results. :thumbsup:
